dashboard-spec.does: Lists the nine built-in tile kinds with default and minimum sizes and capabilities.
Places every tile that has no `layout` with `autoLayout` (existing layouts kept) and prints the spec.
Prints the DashboardSpec v1 JSON Schema (draft 2020-12; also published as `@elabs-ai/components-charts/dashboard/schema.json`).
Runs `validateDashboardSpec`: one `path code message` line per problem (shape, duplicate ids, dangling refs, overlaps, conditions); exit 1 when invalid.

a2ui.does: Lists every type an agent may emit in a surface — props with enums and defaults, required props, events (`on.click` → the host action), whether it takes children — or the full entry for one type.
Prints a small valid surface (Card → Grid of MetricCards → Button with an `on.click` action) to start from.
Prints the A2UI surface v1 JSON Schema (draft 2020-12; also published as `@elabs-ai/components-ai/a2ui/schema.json`) — feed it to a structured-output mode.
Runs `validateA2uiSurface`: one `path code message` line per problem (unknown type/prop/event, enum value, missing required prop, children on a leaf); exit 1 when invalid.

hostedMcpCommand: claude mcp add --transport http brand-ui https://elabs-ai.com/mcp
